figures.finding: No agreement sets a Finnish film director's fee: the directors' guild SELO says its fee recommendations, to which its model contracts refer, are still to be drawn up.
figures.applies: Finland, film and TV directors, as of 2026-11-01.

figures.finding: The directors' guild is Suomen Elokuvaohjaajaliitto SELO (founded 1983, about 220 members in 2024); membership needs directed work of professional standard, such as a theatrically released feature, or a film-directing master's degree; dues are €190 a year (€70 for students and retirees).

sources.said: Jäsenmaksu on 190 euroa täysjäsenelle. Opiskelija- ja eläkeläisjäsenen maksu on 70 euroa. … Suomen Elokuvaohjaajaliitto SELO r.y. on perustettu vuonna 1983 … Jäsenmäärämme on vuonna 2024 noin 220 henkeä.
Tällaisia töitä ovat esimerkiksi elokuvateattereissa levitetyt pitkät elokuvat rahoitustavasta riippumatta

figures.finding: Finland's theatre agreement (TeaTES 2025-2028) pays a staff director at least EUR 2,849.53 a month from 1 August 2025, 2,932.17 from 1 June 2026 and 3,002.54 from 1 June 2027, the foot of the task's range; a guest director's least fee (Liite 8) is that monthly pay times the work's coefficient: 4.5 for normal work (A), 5.5 for demanding or large-scale work (B), 3.5 for small-scale work (C). A director without higher education may be paid 10% less in the first three years; a guest task lasting more months than its coefficient takes the duration's; neither is held.
figures.applies: Finland, professional theatres in Suomen Teatterit ry, 1 March 2025 to 29 February 2028.
